headword: {喜多川歌麿|きたがわうたまろ}

definitions.gloss: Kitagawa Utamaro (c. 1753–1806), ukiyo-e master of portraits of beautiful women
definitions.explanation: An Edo-period ukiyo-e artist celebrated for bijinga, pictures of beautiful women, and especially for his close-up half-length portraits (ōkubi-e) that show the face and expression of each sitter.

examples.japanese: {喜多川歌麿|きたがわうたまろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美人画|びじんが}→美人画：15570_bijinga⟧。
examples.english: A picture of a beauty by Kitagawa Utamaro.

examples.japanese: {歌麿|うたまろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{浮世絵|うきよえ}→浮世絵：13286_ukiyoe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Utamaro's ukiyo-e are popular abroad too.

examples.japanese: {喜多川歌麿|きたがわうたまろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧{大首絵|おおくびえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Kitagawa Utamaro is known for ōkubi-e, which show women's faces in close-up.

notes:
Usually called simply {歌麿|うたまろ}. With ⟦{葛飾北斎|かつしかほくさい}→葛飾北斎：31024_katsushikahokusai⟧ and {歌川広重|うたがわひろしげ}, he is one of the ukiyo-e artists best known in Europe, where his prints influenced the Impressionists.
